name: Campingplatz im Kaunertal
beschreibung: The campsite in Kaunertal is located in the rear part of the Kaunertal in Tirol. The atmosphere is quiet and close to nature. The surroundings are characterized by mountains and nature. The Kaunertaler Gletscher ski area is accessible in winter. In summer, hiking trails are available. The facilities of the site include sanitary facilities, electrical hookups and a communal room. Guests use the campsite as a starting point for activities in the surrounding area.
